newsitem.title: USA: Acordia says Anthem could acquire shares.
newsitem.headline: Acordia says Anthem could acquire shares.

text.p: Acordia Inc said Tuesday it is in discussions with Anthem Insurance Cos Inc, its 67-percent parent, that could include an acquisition by Anthem of the shares of Acordia not currently owned by Anthem.
Acordia also said that Anthem is in discussions with a third party with regard to a possible sale of Acordia's brokerage business.
"There can be no assurance that these discussions will result in any transaction, or if so, as to the terms or timing of any such transaction," Acordia said.
